subject: Action needed: claim technical deep-dive slot or we'll reassign
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@clarity.ai>, Leah Moreno <leah.moreno@clarity.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + next step: technical deep-dive

Hi Samir / Leah,

Thanks for making time earlier — quick recap and next step so nothing slips: on the discovery we covered your ingestion patterns, retention needs, and the two latency targets you mentioned (95th pct under 200ms for short queries; batch embedding throughput of ~3k/min).

Next step: a focused technical deep-dive with an engineer and solutions lead. Given calendar constraints on both sides, can you claim one of these tight windows (all PDT):
- Tue Aug 11 — 11:00–11:30am
- Tue Aug 11 — 3:00–3:30pm
- Wed Aug 12 — 9:00–9:30am

If none work, share two windows that are guaranteed and we'll prioritize. We need a hard yes/no within 24 hours; if we don't hear back we'll assume lower priority and reassign the engineering slot.

Attached are the discovery notes + a proposed agenda. If there's a specific dataset or endpoint you want us to focus on, flag it and we'll prep.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

- We can do 30m. If you can hold 11:00–11:30am PDT on Tue Aug 11 that would be ideal.

If you need an earlier confirmation window from us, please call it out; otherwise I should be able to confirm within the next 6 hours.

—Samir

Thanks Samir — quick note from ops: we have one engineering slot next Tue 11:00–11:30am PDT and it's marked tentative for Clarity until 6pm PDT today. Because that slot is in high demand, we need a hard accept or decline by 6pm — otherwise we'll reassign and offer a later slot next week.

To make this simple: click the calendar link in Neha's original invite (or reply with EXACT attendee emails and we'll send a confirmed invite). If you confirm, we'll include an infra-focused agenda and two short pre-reads; otherwise we'll pivot the session to an enablement call instead of a live perf walk.

Ben Carter

ben.carter@redwood.com
